import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;

    static long modinv(long a, long m) {
        assert m > 0;
        if (m == 1) return 0;
        a %= m;
        if (a < 0) a += m;
        assert a != 0;
        if (a == 1) return 1;
        return (int) (m - modinv(m, a) * m / a);
    }

    static class ModNum {
        int v;

        ModNum() {
            v = 0;
        }

        ModNum(long v_) {
            v = (int) (v_ % MOD);
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
        }

        ModNum(int v) {
            this.v = v;
            if (this.v < 0) this.v += MOD;
        }

        int toInt() {
            return v;
        }

        ModNum add(ModNum o) {
            v += o.v;
            if (v >= MOD) v -= MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModNum sub(ModNum o) {
            v -= o.v;
            if (v < 0) v += MOD;
            return this;
        }

        ModNum mul(ModNum o) {
            v = (int) ((long) v * (long) o.v % MOD);
            return this;
        }

        ModNum div(ModNum o) {
            return mul(o.inv());
        }

        ModNum inv() {
            return new ModNum(modinv(v, MOD));
        }

        static ModNum one() {
            return new ModNum(1);
        }

        static ModNum zero() {
            return new ModNum(0);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        final int n = 6;
        ModNum[][] p = new ModNum[n][n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                p[i][j] = new ModNum(0);
            }
        }
        int _n = sc.nextInt();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            p[i][i] = new ModNum(1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < _n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < _n; j++) {
                int a = sc.nextInt();
                p[i][j] = new ModNum(a).div(new ModNum(100));
            }
        }
        final int f = 20;
        ModNum[][] sets = new ModNum[2][1 << f];
        for (int t = 0; t < 2; t++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < (1 << f); i++) {
                sets[t][i] = new ModNum(0);
            }
        }
        List<List<Integer>> masks = new ArrayList<>();
        masks.add(new ArrayList<>());
        masks.add(new ArrayList<>());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < j; k++) {
                    masks.get(0).add((1 << i) ^ (1 << j) ^ (1 << k));
                    masks.get(1).add((((1 << n) - 1)) ^ masks.get(0).get(masks.get(0).size() - 1));
                }
            }
        }
        assert f == masks.get(0).size();
        for (int t = 0; t < 2; t++) {
            for (int e = 0; e < (1 << (n / 2 * n)); e++) {
                ModNum prob = new ModNum(1);
                int[] edges = new int[n / 2];
                for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) edges[i] = 0;
                for (int i = 0; i < n / 2 * n; i++) {
                    boolean r = ((e >> i) & 1) == 1;
                    ModNum pp = p[(i / n) * 2 + t][i % n];
                    if (r) {
                        prob = prob.mul(pp);
                    } else {
                        ModNum one = ModNum.one();
                        ModNum sub = one.sub(pp);
                        prob = prob.mul(sub);
                    }
                    edges[i / n] |= (r ? 1 : 0) << (i % n);
                }
                int work_mask = 0;
                for (int a = 0; a < masks.get(t).size(); a++) {
                    int mask = masks.get(t).get(a);
                    int[] r = new int[n / 2];
                    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; i++) r[i] = edges[i] & mask;
                    if (r[0] != 0 && r[1] != 0 && r[2] != 0) {
                        if (Integer.bitCount(r[0] | r[1] | r[2]) == 3) {
                            int x = Integer.bitCount(r[0] | r[1]);
                            int y = Integer.bitCount(r[0] | r[2]);
                            int z = Integer.bitCount(r[1] | r[2]);
                            if (x >= 2 && y >= 2 && z >= 2) {
                                work_mask |= (1 << a);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                sets[t][work_mask] = sets[t][work_mask].add(prob);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < f; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << f); j++) {
                if (((j >> i) & 1) == 1) continue;
                sets[0][j ^ (1 << i)] = sets[0][j ^ (1 << i)].add(sets[0][j]);
            }
        }
        ModNum ans = new ModNum(0);
        for (int j = 0; j < (1 << f); j++) {
            ans = ans.add(sets[0][j].mul(sets[1][((1 << f) - 1) ^ j]));
        }
        ans = ModNum.one().sub(ans);
        System.out.println(ans.toInt());
    }
}
